name: AIZPT314 sell pricing counts the burned half as reserve
summary: AIZPT's built-in ERC314 pool prices a sell as if the whole amount entered its token reserve but adds only half and burns the rest, so the reserve stays low and each small sell gets an inflated BNB price. The attacker bought with 8,000 flash-loaned BNB and sold the tokens back in 200 small transfers to the contract, draining its BNB.
notes: Loss is the contract's BNB reserve across the anchor and two copycats (0xcd5e7b69, 0x2137867e), each a flash-loaned buy followed by many small sells; the AIZPT tokens leaving the reserve are valued at nothing (rule 12). The 4.1 BNB to 0x36696169 is the PancakeSwap v3 flash-loan fee, paid out of the drained BNB.
